description: This Java test class contains unit tests for the ImmutableMappingContext class, verifying its immutability and equality semantics.

classes.name: ImmutableMappingContextTest
classes.description: A JUnit test class testing the immutability and equality of ImmutableMappingContext instances.

methods.name: testHashCodeAndEquals
methods.description: Verifies that ImmutableMappingContext correctly implements hashCode() and equals() methods with the help of EqualsVerifier.

methods.name: assertImmutability
methods.description: Checks that ImmutableMappingContext is immutable and that it depends on JsonObject being immutable.
